sources.title: Common Names for Ingredients and Components
List of ingredients and allergens on food labels
Labelling requirements for fats and oils

ingredients.name: Citric acid
ingredients.what_it_is: Citric acid is an organic acid found naturally in citrus fruits.
ingredients.why_used: It preserves foods and controls their acidity.
ingredients.explanation: Used as a preservative and pH control agent in many packaged foods.

ingredients.name: Cocoa butter
ingredients.what_it_is: Cocoa butter is the fat extracted from cacao beans.
ingredients.why_used: It provides texture and structure in chocolate products.
ingredients.explanation: A plant-derived fat used in chocolate and confectionery.

ingredients.name: Yeast
ingredients.what_it_is: Yeast is a single-celled fungus used in food production.
ingredients.why_used: It promotes rising of baked goods.
ingredients.explanation: A leavening agent that produces carbon dioxide to make dough rise.

ingredients.name: Vinegar
ingredients.what_it_is: Vinegar is a dilute solution of acetic acid.
ingredients.why_used: It preserves foods and adds a sour taste.
ingredients.explanation: On Canadian labels, vinegar may refer to wine, spirit, malt, cider, or other specified types.

ingredients.name: Baking soda
ingredients.what_it_is: Baking soda is sodium bicarbonate.
ingredients.why_used: It promotes rising of baked goods.
ingredients.explanation: A leavening agent that reacts with acids to produce carbon dioxide.

ingredients.name: Milk
ingredients.what_it_is: Milk is the liquid produced by mammals, most commonly cows.
ingredients.why_used: It provides moisture, protein, and fat in foods.
ingredients.explanation: On Canadian labels, various forms of milk may be grouped as milk ingredients.

ingredients.name: Palm oil
ingredients.what_it_is: Palm oil is a vegetable oil from the fruit of oil palms.
ingredients.why_used: It supplies fat when preparing foods.
ingredients.explanation: A plant-derived fat listed among saturated fat sources by Health Canada.

ingredients.name: Cocoa mass
ingredients.what_it_is: Cocoa mass is ground cacao beans containing both cocoa solids and cocoa butter.
ingredients.why_used: It provides the base chocolate flavor and color in confectionery.
ingredients.explanation: A processed cacao product used to make chocolate.

ingredients.name: Cocoa
ingredients.what_it_is: Cocoa is the powder remaining after cocoa butter is removed from cocoa mass.
ingredients.why_used: It adds chocolate flavor to foods.
ingredients.explanation: A processed cacao product providing flavor without the full fat content of cocoa butter.

ingredients.name: Almonds
ingredients.what_it_is: Almonds are tree nuts from the almond tree.
ingredients.why_used: They add flavor, texture, and nutrition to foods.
ingredients.explanation: Almonds are a priority food allergen in Canada and must be declared on labels.

ingredients.name: Peanuts
ingredients.what_it_is: Peanuts are legumes commonly used in foods.
ingredients.why_used: They add flavor, texture, protein, and fat to foods.
ingredients.explanation: Peanuts are a priority food allergen in Canada and must be declared on labels.

ingredients.name: Maltodextrin
ingredients.what_it_is: Maltodextrin is a starch-derived carbohydrate.
ingredients.why_used: It adds bulk and texture to processed foods.
ingredients.explanation: A common food additive used as a thickener and filler.

ingredients.name: Dextrose
ingredients.what_it_is: Dextrose is a simple sugar chemically identical to glucose.
ingredients.why_used: It adds sweetness.
ingredients.explanation: A sweetener derived from starch, commonly from corn.

ingredients.name: Lactic acid
ingredients.what_it_is: Lactic acid is an organic acid produced by fermentation.
ingredients.why_used: It controls acidity and prevents spoilage.
ingredients.explanation: Used as a pH control agent and acidulant in packaged foods.

ingredients.name: Pectin
ingredients.what_it_is: Pectin is a naturally occurring polysaccharide found in fruits.
ingredients.why_used: It produces a gel-like texture and acts as a thickener.
ingredients.explanation: A stabilizer and thickener commonly used in jams and jellies.

ingredients.name: Whey powder
ingredients.what_it_is: Whey powder is dried whey, the liquid portion of milk remaining after cheese making.
ingredients.why_used: It adds protein and improves texture in foods.
ingredients.explanation: On Canadian labels, whey and whey derivatives may be grouped under milk-derived ingredients.

ingredients.name: Rice flour
ingredients.what_it_is: Rice flour is flour made by milling rice.
ingredients.why_used: It serves as a gluten-free flour alternative.
ingredients.explanation: A grain-based flour used in baking and as a thickener.

ingredients.name: Tapioca starch
ingredients.what_it_is: Tapioca starch is extracted from the cassava root.
ingredients.why_used: It thickens and stabilizes foods.
ingredients.explanation: A plant-derived starch commonly used as a thickener.

ingredients.name: Sunflower lecithin
ingredients.what_it_is: Sunflower lecithin is an emulsifier derived from sunflower seeds.
ingredients.why_used: It allows smooth mixing and prevents separation.
ingredients.explanation: An emulsifier used as an alternative to soy lecithin.

ingredients.name: Calcium carbonate
ingredients.what_it_is: Calcium carbonate is a mineral compound.
ingredients.why_used: It adds calcium as a nutrient and acts as a leavening agent.
ingredients.explanation: Used both as a nutrient supplement and a leavening agent in foods.

ingredients.name: Spices
ingredients.what_it_is: Spices are dried plant-derived seasonings.
ingredients.why_used: They add flavor to foods.
ingredients.explanation: On Canadian labels, individual spices may be listed collectively as spices.

ingredients.name: Enzymes
ingredients.what_it_is: Enzymes are proteins that catalyze chemical reactions in foods.
ingredients.why_used: They modify proteins, polysaccharides, and fats during food processing.
ingredients.explanation: Enzyme preparations are used in cheese making, baking, and other food processes.

ingredients.name: Flavouring
ingredients.what_it_is: Flavouring substances add specific flavors to foods.
ingredients.why_used: They add or enhance flavor.
ingredients.explanation: On Canadian labels, flavourings from chemical synthesis must be declared as artificial.

ingredients.name: Wheat
ingredients.what_it_is: Wheat is a cereal grain.
ingredients.why_used: It provides structure, starch, and protein in foods.
ingredients.explanation: Wheat is a priority food allergen in Canada and must be declared on labels.

ingredients.name: Whole grain wheat
ingredients.what_it_is: Whole grain wheat includes the bran, germ, and endosperm of the wheat kernel.
ingredients.why_used: It provides fibre and nutrients in grain products.
ingredients.explanation: Whole grains are recommended by Canada's Food Guide as a source of fibre.

ingredients.name: Wheat bran
ingredients.what_it_is: Wheat bran is the outer layer of the wheat kernel.
ingredients.why_used: It adds dietary fibre to foods.
ingredients.explanation: A source of dietary fibre often added to cereals and baked goods.

ingredients.name: Barley malt extract
ingredients.what_it_is: Barley malt extract is a sweetener derived from sprouted barley.
ingredients.why_used: It adds sweetness and flavor to foods.
ingredients.explanation: A natural sweetener and flavoring commonly used in cereals and baked goods.

ingredients.name: Bacterial culture
ingredients.what_it_is: Bacterial cultures are live bacteria used in food fermentation.
ingredients.why_used: They ferment dairy and other foods to produce flavors and textures.
ingredients.explanation: On Canadian labels, bacteria species may be listed collectively as bacterial culture.

ingredients.name: Ascorbic acid
ingredients.what_it_is: Ascorbic acid is vitamin C.
ingredients.why_used: It preserves foods and is added as a nutrient.
ingredients.explanation: Used both as a preservative to prevent spoilage and as a nutrient supplement.

ingredients.name: Soya
ingredients.what_it_is: Soya refers to the soybean plant and its products.
ingredients.why_used: It provides protein and oil in foods.
ingredients.explanation: Soy is a priority food allergen in Canada and must be declared on labels.

ingredients.name: Enriched wheat flour
ingredients.what_it_is: Enriched wheat flour is wheat flour with added vitamins and minerals.
ingredients.why_used: It replaces vitamins and minerals lost during milling.
ingredients.explanation: Enrichment adds nutrients such as niacin, riboflavin, folic acid, and iron back to refined flour.
